requestAd.title: New Ad Account Request
requestAd.subtitle: Complete the registration form for
requestAd.selectPlatform: Select the ad platform you want to add
requestAd.fullNamePlaceholder: Enter full name as on ID card
requestAd.security2faDesc: Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) is a process that requires users to prove their identity in two different ways before gaining access to the system. For example, logging in using an email address or phone number, then entering the correct password or pin.
requestAd.agree2fa1: I am aware that if there is an admin who does not activate 2FA and commits negligence causing the account to be hacked, the ad balance used by the hacker cannot be refunded by meta/reviewed by the platform.
requestAd.agree2fa2: All decisions regarding balance refunds due to hacking incidents are entirely up to the platform (Meta/Google/TikTok).
requestAd.agreePolicy: I understand and agree to all platform policies. I am willing to bear all risks if there is a violation of the platform's policies.
requestAd.tcDef11: 1.1 "Ads Account" means Tentaklik's whitelisted advertising account on the Digital Advertising Platform that will be given access to you in connection with the use of Whitelisted Account Support.
requestAd.tcDef12: 1.2 "Ad Credit" means the balance held in the Ads Account provided by Tentaklik to you according to the amount of Top-Up Funds that can be used to conduct advertising activities on the Digital Advertising Platform.
requestAd.tcDef13: 1.3 "Top-Up Funds" means a sum of funds paid by you in connection with the use of Whitelisted Account Support which will be accommodated and become your Ad Credit balance.
requestAd.tcDef14: 1.4 "Digital Advertising Platform" means an online platform that you can use to conduct advertising activities using an Ads Account in connection with Whitelisted Account Support, namely Meta, Google, TikTok, and/or other platforms.
requestAd.tcDef15: 1.5 "Whitelisted Account Support" means the advertising activity support service on the Digital Advertising Platform using the Ads Account provided by Tentaklik to you.
requestAd.tcDef16: 1.6 "CPAS (Facebook Collaborative Ads)" means connecting the Ad Account service with the marketplace, which allows the execution of ads using catalogs and audience targeting based on visit data on the marketplace, in accordance with the relevant platform's terms and policies.
requestAd.tcSvc21a: Tentaklik will provide advertising services in accordance with the services available on Tentaklik.
requestAd.tcSvc21b: Tentaklik services include, but are not limited to: Provision of 24-hour automatic top-up facilities for Facebook and Google platforms.
requestAd.tcSvc21c: Provision of ad content review in accordance with Tentaklik's advertising standards which include the terms and conditions of the Digital Advertising Platform.
requestAd.tcSvc21d: Users will get a maximum of 1 (one) Ads Account at the beginning of the Service. Tentaklik has the right to gradually increase the number of your Ads Accounts based on its unilateral consideration.
requestAd.tcSvc21e: Provide support for additional ad accounts and business managers needed by users in accordance with the Tentaklik team's approval.
requestAd.tcSvc21f: Regulate user ads which includes the closure/termination of campaigns/ad accounts from users if ad violations are found.
requestAd.tcSvc22Desc: By registering on the Tentaklik platform, it indicates that the user has agreed to all advertising T&C using the Tentaklik Ads Service.
requestAd.tcRespDesc: Tentaklik is committed to ensuring that ads running under Tentaklik accounts comply with Tentaklik standards which include the terms and conditions of the Digital Advertising Platform. If the Ads Account that has been given to you is regulated not due to your violation, then Tentaklik will provide a replacement Ads Account directly.
requestAd.tcFeeADesc: You are obliged to pay a "Management Fee" to Tentaklik of: Facebook Platform (4%) and Google Platform (3%). Payment of the Management Fee will be made by direct deduction from the amount of your Top-Up Funds.
requestAd.tcFeeBDesc: You must pay an "Account Fee" to Tentaklik every month, for each Ads Account used. The Account Fee is {fee}.
requestAd.agreeTc: I agree to the applicable Terms and Conditions. If I violate these rules, I am willing to accept all applicable consequences.
requestAd.durationDesc: Select the active period for your ad account before submitting the account request.
requestAd.successMsg: Account request successfully created. Your balance is temporarily withheld.
requestAd.errNoUser: User not found. Please log in again.
